text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq celebrates "Science Day" marking the day Iraq launched missiles against Israel in 1991.
- Vice-Chairman of the Revolutionay Command Council Izzat Ibrahim lays a wreath to the martyrs' monument on the sixth anniversary of the Gulf War.
- Sudanese community in Iraq organises a rally in Baghdad condemning the 1991 Gulf War.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
